SELECT
    c.GovernmentForm,
    SUM(c.Population) AS TotalPopulation
FROM
    country c
WHERE
    c.GovernmentForm IN (
        SELECT
            GovernmentForm
        FROM
            country
        GROUP BY
            GovernmentForm
        HAVING
            AVG(LifeExpectancy) > 72
    )
GROUP BY
    c.GovernmentForm;
